context.research_question: Which authored TR candidate retains at least 20% of each fully recovered component while preserving verified finite-RF quantum dynamics and unbiased full-FID signal amounts?
context.target_rationale: Require amount error <=0.05, full-complex-FID residual <=0.02, per-component retained signal norm >=0.2, RF refinement <=0.002 and physical/periodic density error <=1e-10. Choose the shortest TR only among candidates passing every unchanged gate.
context.assumptions: Authored singlet and synthetic AB, local independent Lindblad baths, common equilibrium polarization, ideal product-basis dephasing at ADC end. No spatial PRESS/crusher, molecular Redfield, measured spectra, concentration calibration or scanner certification.
